svg.text: Public site served only through CloudFront · admin reachable only through an IAM-authenticated SSM tunnel · no outbound internet while running
Private subnet 10.0.1.0/24 · no public IP addresses
Global · the only public entry point
on only for deploys and admin sessions
IMDSv2 only · encrypted EBS · no SSH key · termination protection
Security group: port 8000 from CloudFront only
Docker Compose: read-only file systems, all Linux capabilities dropped
Secrets written from Parameter Store to root-only files at deploy time
Image scanned with Trivy before push
Instance role reads only these values
temporary credentials from SSO, used to open the tunnel
Region lock, no IAM users or keys
Logs kept in the Security account
Admin access (blocked at the edge for visitors)
Outbound through NAT, only while deploying or administering
